scenario.summary: Signs in as the class's retail account, opens the Lawn Care PLP, adds the first product to the wishlist, then removes it from My Account > Wishlist.
steps: Click Login, sign in with the sheet account
Open the category from the menu, verify product details
Click the first product's wishlist icon, verify the success message
Remove the first wishlist product, verify 'no records' text
stateChanges: Account wishlist: first listed product added, then removed (net unchanged if the wishlist was empty)
assertions: Wishlist remove link and no-record text
evidence: DECLARED ACCOUNT (per method): verifyWishListFunctionalityForRetailUser signs in with loginPage.customerSuccessfullLogin(testClassRetailUsers/productListingPageTest Username, Password; loginAndRegistration!B179/C179) and the later methods of the class (priority 100-125) run in that signed-in session until productListingPageLoggOffTheUser. Convention: every method that signs in or reuses the signed-in session declares user = USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED {store}, preferred {source: the username source, required: true} (Tda.declareUser -> useExisting). Username/password stay credential sources (masked); the scanner recorded them only on the sign-in method, later methods declare the same two cells from the test source (the session they reuse).

lawn = CATEGORY_WITH_PRODUCTS {store, minProducts 1, topLevel true}: opened from the Departments menu by its label (homePage!B18 'Lawn Care' -> lawn.name); the checks are structural (every listed product shows image, name, SKU, rating, reviews link, price, inventory), so any top-level category with products fits. No preferred: the identity is the CategoryCode and the sheet holds the display name. Same params as verifyListedProductsDetail, so both resolve the same category.
The wishlist check removes the FIRST wishlist row and expects the list empty afterwards: the account's wishlist must be empty before the test (not a key constraint; gap noted for review).
Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware), the same store as the Selenium pdp/quickOrder entries.
Profile: work/profiles/profile.json has no observations for these Selenium cells (profiled false); DB facts from bin/tda rows (2026-11-10) where cited.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, map key prefixes, regex) are framework constants: role config, no need.
migrate: Selenium reads Excel tables through TestData.getMap / getHashMap; there is no swap for Selenium.
